column1: # BASELINE of TILT DETACHED sites -- r7123 (node 66), on node 70's mutation instrument.  Data, not code.
# ** A RECORD OF ADJUDICATIONS, NOT A LIST OF EXEMPTIONS ** -- the same rule as the other two baselines.
#   One line per site:  receipt <TAB> expression <TAB> verdict <TAB> what was read
# ** WHAT DETACHED MEANS. **  A float pin that neither moves nor flips when every float the receipt reads
# is tilted by a smooth 5 per cent -- in a receipt the tilt demonstrably REACHED.  *** The defect is an
# assertion that passes on something other than its own measurement. ***
# ** WHY THIS IS GATE-GRADE NOW AND WAS NOT AT r7113. **  Both of the operator's false-positive classes are
# closed BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by tuning:
#   - the IMPORT ROUTE is hooked, so a receipt that reads its measurement by importing an instrument is
#     perturbed like any other (C62's two DAMPX pins go from clean to 2.2e-2 and 8.2e-3 and FAIL; its r_D
#     equality moves 7.103 -> 6.910 instead of staying bit-identical);
#   - CONSTANT is an exemption class for a pin whose operand traces only to literals and arithmetic, and
#     it must ACTUALLY COMPUTE -- a bare literal compared with itself stays DETACHED, because it checks
#     nothing.
# ⇒ Site precision went 2 of 9 to 2 of 2 on the same 69 receipts.  ⌗ *Node 70 corrected this seat's own
# arithmetic here: an r7119 order wrote `3/9 -> 7/9` on 70's earlier inconsistent scoring, and the honest
# before-figure was 2 of 9.  The repair is the same; the figure was not.*
# ** NOT REACHED IS NOT CLEAN. **  Three receipts the tilt does not reach are reported as unmeasured and
# never as passing, which is the distinction that makes the precision figure mean anything.
# ** QUANTISED IS ADJUDICATED AS AN EXEMPTION CLASS -- r7125 (node 66), ON cc66's REQUEST AT r7123+cc66.92,
# AND THE ADJUDICATION IS THE GATE'S AND NOT 70's (standing rule: a seat does not edit another seat's
# receipt; adjudications remain the gate's).  cc66 addressed the request to 70; 70 may CONTEST IT WITH A
# MEASUREMENT and the class reverses on one, which is why the three conditions below are measurable ones. **
#   THE CLASS: a pin whose operand is QUANTISED coarser than the tilt's reach -- here an integer peak
#   position from argrelextrema on a step-8 abscissa, which a smooth 5 per cent tilt cannot move because
#   one quantum is 9.6 and the tilt's reach on that quantity is 0.65.  It is the sibling of CONSTANT, and
#   it is the one place TILT cannot resolve below the measurement's own resolution.
#   ⛔ AND IT CARRIES CONSTANT's OWN CONDITION, WHICH IS WHAT KEEPS IT FROM BEING A PERMISSION SLIP.  The
#   exemption holds only where all three are shown, not asserted:
#     (1) the operand is demonstrably quantised, with the quantum READ FROM THE ABSCISSA and not declared;
#     (2) the tilt's reach on that operand is MEASURED and recorded as smaller than one quantum;
#     (3) a GRID-FREE assertion stands beside the figure pin, so nothing in the receipt rests on the
#         quantised pin alone.
#   ⇒ Without (3) the verdict would protect a pin that checks nothing, which is exactly the failure the
#   CONSTANT class was given its own must-actually-compute condition for.
#   ✔ BOTH ROWS BELOW MEET ALL THREE as cc66 wrote them: the window is derived by `grid_step` from the
#   banked grid and refuses a non-uniform one, the 14.8x-versus-9.6 figure is the reach measurement, and
#   the shape assertion (first three residuals positive and strictly decreasing, tail flat inside two bins,
#   control carrying no decaying transient) is grid-free and was verified over 43 re-gridded trees.
#   ⌗ THE STATED LIMIT, PER STANDING ORDER r7013 ②, AND IT IS NOT AN OWED ITEM: TILT cannot discriminate a
#   quantised pin that is sound from one that is stale, because neither moves.  What covers those digits is
#   not this operator but the QUOTE-PIN work ordered to 70 at r7125 -- the +142, +80, +18 of these two
#   receipts are quoted by C56, by P15_the_spacing_is_right_and_the_acoustic_phase_is_wrong and by the P15
#   appendix, and a pin on a quoted figure is that operator's subject and not this one's.
# ** AND cc66's CEILING MOVE 2 -> 0 IN check_tilt_pins.py IS ACCEPTED, r7125. **  Both OWED sites are
# repaired, so a ceiling of 2 would be a standing permission for two new ones.  The cross-seat edit is
# allowed here because a ceiling can only TIGHTEN the gate and the move is visible in one line; an edit
# that loosened another seat's gate would not be.
# ⛔ THE GATE (corpus/check_tilt_pins.py) FAILS ON: a DETACHED site not listed here, a listed site no
# longer reported, and any RISE in the OWED count.  It runs in the monthly backstop and not per push,
# because its cost is one receipt run per site -- the same shape as the tolerance sweep beside it.

column4: r7123+cc66.92: the OWED site here is REPAIRED -- `abs(r_c[i] - v) < 6` is replaced by a window DERIVED from the abscissa (`grid_step` reads the banked grid and refuses a non-uniform one) plus a grid-free SHAPE assertion: the first three residuals POSITIVE and STRICTLY DECREASING, the first 14.8x the 9.6 one bin would move it, the tail flat inside two bins, and the control carrying no decaying transient. All five forms verified over 43 re-gridded trees; the old window failed 11 of them and the unflagged control pin `max(abs(r_l[:3])) < 20` failed 5, and that one is repaired too. ** THIS ROW IS THE SURVIVING FIGURE PIN AND IT IS DETACHED BY THE NATURE OF THE QUANTITY, NOT BY A DEFECT: ** the operand is an INTEGER peak position from argrelextrema on a step-8 grid, so a smooth 5 per cent tilt is below its quantum by construction and cannot move it -- the sibling of the CONSTANT class, and the one case where TILT cannot resolve below the measurement's own resolution. The pin is KEPT because the record's +142, +80, +18 are quoted by C56, P15_the_spacing_is_right_and_the_acoustic_phase_is_wrong and the P15 appendix, and the shape assertion beside it passes under a one-bin move, so nothing else would notice the digits drifting. ** QUANTISED is a verdict label this seat introduces and node 70 should rule on it: ** accept it as an exemption class beside CONSTANT, or say the figure pin should go and the shape carry it alone -- r7123 offered both forms and this seat took both, as it did for C63.
